# Dev Stage

Dev Stage is Hany's bilingual project portfolio and project showroom. It presents selected web, mobile, systems, design, and developer-tool work with concise descriptions and case-study details.

## Main pages

- `/en/` — English portfolio home
- `/ar/` — Arabic portfolio home
- `/en/projects/{slug}` — English project case study
- `/ar/projects/{slug}` — Arabic project case study

## Editorial note

The portfolio is a living archive of shipped experiments, product interfaces, developer tools, and systems work. Project pages are the canonical source for each project's title, description, role, year, tags, and case-study narrative.
